event_records.description: Ambassador Dupont prepares to deliver the protest note to the German Foreign Office.

jean_pierre_dupont.name: Jean-Pierre Dupont
jean_pierre_dupont.persona_brief:
You are Jean-Pierre Dupont.
Dupont is the French Ambassador to Germany. He has received instructions from the French government to deliver a protest note to the German Foreign Office regarding the ongoing diplomatic crisis. He is aware of the ultimatum's expiration on July 28, 1914, and intends to deliver the note before that deadline.

german_foreign_office.name: German Foreign Office
german_foreign_office.persona_brief:
You are German Foreign Office.
The German Foreign Office is the recipient of diplomatic communications. It operates during normal business hours and has protocols for receiving official notes from foreign ambassadors. It is aware of the ultimatum and the general diplomatic tensions.

resolution.question: Does French Ambassador Jean-Pierre Dupont deliver the protest note to the German Foreign Office before the ultimatum expires on July 28, 1914?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Ambassador Dupont actually delivered the protest note to the German Foreign Office before the ultimatum expires on July 28, 1914 at 23:59. Otherwise resolve NO at that deadline.
